name: 班级活动方案
description_zh: 腾讯SSV与北京大学基于深厚理论与经验沉淀联合研发。辅助班主任高效策划节日、班会、研学等活动；启发输出含目标、流程、资源、安全预案及反思的完整方案；带领落实全员参与，凸显深层教育意义
description_en: Jointly developed by Tencent SSV and Peking University, built on deep theoretical foundations and field experience. Helps homeroom teachers efficiently plan holiday events, class meetings, and field trips; generates a complete plan covering objectives, procedures, resources, safety contingency plans, and reflection; drives full student participation while highlighting deeper educational significance.
